caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A broad weekly-strategy headline uses a large lavender rough-display tag for the key phrase, followed by a one-line flexibility caveat.
visual_anatomy.layout: A three-zone operational map: four content-strategy source cards at left route into a seven-day spine in the middle, while comment and direct-message routines sit as two detailed working panels on the right.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Headline → left content cards → trace their arrows to named days in the centre → follow the connector spine to commenting and direct-message routines on the right.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large lightweight headline, oversized dark module labels, bold mini-headings, and compact actionable copy inside cards and message examples.
visual_anatomy.colour: Pink tints mark content-strategy source cards, lavender marks the weekly spine, aqua marks commenting, and blue marks direct messages; the split background quietly repeats the same left-to-right grouping.
visual_anatomy.surface: White header over a pale pink-to-aqua work field, black routed connectors with round junction markers, rounded cards, and soft drop shadows.
visual_anatomy.modules: Four content cards, seven day tiles, a comment routine card with examples, and a direct-message routine card with examples.
visual_anatomy.density: Very high: it contains a schedule, source taxonomy, and two support routines, but the connector topology prevents it becoming a flat checklist.

motion.observed_state_change: Sampled frames show coloured junction markers moving along the connector paths and temporary horizontal masking/reveal of day labels and text rows before the full schedule is restored.
motion.motion_job: Bring the hidden routing between content, days, commenting, and direct outreach into focus before leaving a static schedule the reader can revisit.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Understand how recurring activities connect across a week rather than treating them as an unprioritised content list.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Use a time spine as the stable reference, then draw only the routes that change what happens on a day or feed a supporting routine.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use when actions genuinely have schedule or dependency relationships; do not add connector lines merely to make a calendar look more complex.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the weekly posting routine, days, content categories, comment or DM scripts, routed-map geometry, title tags, colour roles, or animated marker behavior.

claim_boundary.note: The frequency, engagement, and direct-message recommendations are visible creator guidance, not verified operating evidence for another audience.
